responsibility: Implements the main executable VxWorks target helpers used by multiple back ends. It provides special constructor/destructor section emission for VxWorks configurations that require numbered .ctors/.dtors sections, defines the emulated TLS control-object layout and initializer used when the OS lacks native TLS, performs VxWorks-specific target option override work such as enabling emutls, constraining PIC to RTP mode, and forcing strict DWARF defaults, and emits direct cacheTextUpdate calls for __builtin___clear_cache. This file is the backend/helper implementation companion to the macro-heavy configuration in vxworks.h and vxworksae.h.
same_name_distinction: In the vxworks same-name group, this is the implementation file for target helper routines such as ctor/dtor section emission, emulated TLS support, option override behavior, and __clear_cache lowering; gcc/config/vxworks.h is the macro/spec configuration header, and gcc/config/vxworks.opt is only the option table.
